slides.headline: How to reply to a bad Glassdoor review without making it worse
Write for the candidate, not the reviewer.
slides.body: The person you're convincing is the one reading next week.

slides.headline: Never reveal employment details.
slides.body: Why someone left, their performance, their pay — none of it goes in a public reply.

slides.headline: Never guess who wrote it.
slides.body: Even hinting at an identity is a privacy and legal risk.

slides.headline: Point to what's changed.
slides.body: One concrete thing you've fixed beats a paragraph of values.

slides.headline: And if it shouldn't be there at all, don't reply. Send it to us.
Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
